title: pi-session-rename config
description: <agent-dir>/extensions/session-rename.json, read on each title request. There is no implicit model: without one, titles are not generated.

$schema.description: Editor JSON Schema reference; not a runtime setting.

fallbackModels.description: Further title models tried in order when an earlier one lacks credentials or its reply fails (error, cut off, not title JSON).

fallbacks.description: Legacy name for fallbackModels, read only when fallbackModels is not an array.

thinking.description: Legacy default thinking level for entries that set none.

provider.description: Provider name; also the auth.json entry used for baseUrl entries.

thinking.description: Reasoning level; baseUrl entries send it as reasoning_effort capped at high. Defaults to the top-level thinking, else low.

baseUrl.description: Call this OpenAI Chat Completions base URL directly with the provider's auth.json key (key, else access; none means keyless). Without it, the entry needs Pi's model registry and credentials.
